description: Create a hosted map style. Provide a name, optionally a named `base` to start from (light, dark, streets, midnight, navigator-day, navigator-night, fleet, outdoor, dataviz, backdrop, print - call list_style_layers for what each one is for), and optionally a theme document ({base: "light"|"dark", palette: {slot: colour}, layers: {layer_id: overrides}}). The named base is laid down first and the theme document is merged over it, so "streets with darker water" is one call; with neither, the style starts from the default theme. A theme may also set worldview (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, accepted: AE, KR, SA, US) to display that jurisdiction's official names for a small curated registry of renamed features; omitted, labels keep the OSM on-the-ground names. Returns the generated style_id (pass it to set_palette / set_layer_paint) and the compiled style URL for MapLibre.

base.description:
Optional named base to start from, e.g. "streets", "midnight",
"navigator-night", "fleet". Call `list_style_layers` for the
catalogue, including which bases expect an overlay of their own. The
base's whole document is laid down first and `theme` is merged over
it, so a base plus two palette entries is a complete style. Omitted,
the style starts from the default light theme as it always did.

name.description: Human-readable style name; its kebab-case slug seeds the style id.

theme.description:
Optional theme document (palette/layer overrides). Merged over
`base` when one is given; on its own, it replaces the default theme
outright.

name: create_style

style_id.description:
The generated style id — pass it to `set_palette`,
`set_layer_paint` and `get_style`.

style_url.description: Immutable URL of the compiled style at this version.

theme.description: The theme document that was stored.
